item.title: Creating a Google Calendar (.ICS) from a Holiday List: A Practical Guide
item.description:
Creating a Google Calendar (.ICS) from a Holiday List: A Practical Guide

Managing public holidays is much easier when they are available directly in your digital calendar. During this project, the objective was to convert a tabular holiday notification into a format that could be imported into Google Calendar while also supporting recurring weekly holidays such as second and fourth Saturdays.

This post documents the complete workflow, from extracting holidays from an image to preparing data for ICS, VCS, and CSV formats.

item.title: How to Build a Comprehensive Government Website for the Sikkim Local Fund Audit Directorate (SLFA)
item.description:
How to Build a Comprehensive Government Website for the Sikkim Local Fund Audit Directorate (SLFA)

A modern government website is more than an online brochure. It is a platform for transparency, accountability, public communication, and citizen services.

For the Sikkim Local Fund Audit (SLFA), the website should serve as the official source of information relating to local fund audits, audit reports, statutory provisions, annual reports, RTI disclosures, circulars, publications, and citizen services.

item.title: Building a Comprehensive Sikkim Local Fund Audit Manual: From Concept to Publication
item.description:
Building a Comprehensive Sikkim Local Fund Audit Manual: From Concept to Publication

Government auditing depends on consistency, legal compliance, and documented procedures. An audit manual provides that consistency by establishing a common reference for auditors, supervisory officers, and auditee institutions.

This article documents the planning and design of a comprehensive Sikkim Local Fund Audit Manual. The objective is to create a practical handbook that combines legislation, audit methodology, standard operating procedures, reporting formats, and best practices into a single reference document.

item.title: Designing an End-to-End Audit Process Workflow: From Intimation Letter to Final Settlement Report
item.description:
Designing an End-to-End Audit Process Workflow

A well-defined audit workflow is essential for ensuring consistency, transparency, accountability, and timely completion of audits. Whether the process is manual or implemented in an Audit Management System, every audit activity should have a clearly defined owner, predecessor, successor, and approval hierarchy.

This article presents a structured audit workflow for Local Fund Audits of Panchayats, beginning with the issue of the audit intimation letter and ending with the closure of audit observations through the Action Taken Report (ATR).

item.title: Building a Sikkim Pay Fixation Calculator: Understanding Rule 12 and Developing a Web-Based Promotion Pay Calculator
item.description:
Building a Sikkim Pay Fixation Calculator: Understanding Rule 12 and Developing a Web-Based Promotion Pay Calculator

Government employees are often confused about how their pay is fixed after promotion. Although the Sikkim Government Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2018 provide detailed provisions, manually calculating the revised pay can be time-consuming and prone to errors.

In this project, we built a web-based Pay Fixation Calculator that follows Rule 12 of the Sikkim Revised Pay Rules, 2018 and uses the official Pay Matrix for automatic calculations.

item.title: Automating GST Return PDF Audits with Python: Extract Tables and Text at Scale
item.description: Learn how to build Python scripts using tabula-py and pdfplumber to extract structured tables and text from GST return PDFs at scale.

item.title: Building a Practical GST Compliance Audit Framework: From Raw Records to Professional Audit Reports
item.description:
Building a Practical GST Compliance Audit Framework

Over the course of this project, the goal was not simply to prepare another GST audit report. The objective was to build a repeatable audit methodology that can be used by government auditors, internal auditors, chartered accountants, and finance professionals for conducting GST compliance audits efficiently.

The work evolved from preparing simple audit observations into developing a structured audit framework, reusable templates, reconciliation tools, reporting formats, and workflow automation.

item.title: Building an Audit Report Analysis System with GitHub Pages, JavaScript, GitHub Actions, and Python
item.description:
Building an Audit Report Analysis System with GitHub Pages

Managing hundreds of audit reports becomes increasingly difficult as the number of local bodies, audit years, and observations grows. Traditional document storage makes searching, comparing, and analyzing reports time-consuming.

This project aims to transform audit reports into a searchable knowledge base using GitHub Pages, GitHub Actions, JavaScript, and a small amount of Python.

The result is a completely free system that automatically converts reports, builds an index, and provides an interactive website for browsing audit reports.
